title: Product ad from nothing
pitch: A hero still, the same product moving, a second camera on the same moment, a score, cut on the beat.
why: Reshoot films the first clip again from a new angle, so the product in the second shot is the same one, not a lookalike. That is what keeps an ad from falling apart.

fields.label: The product
fields.default: a faceted perfume bottle of smoked glass with a gold cap and no label

models.name: FLUX.3 Klein

tips: Plain surfaces with no print: blank products invent logos when they are told nothing.
Name the product's shape and colours in the second camera's words too, and keep the move small: a wide orbit invents the far side of the bottle.
Reshoot is the slow step, about 8 minutes here.

steps.label: Cut on the beat
steps.what: Finds the tempo and beats in the song, picks its loudest section, and cuts each clip on a beat. Loudness normalized.

tested.note: A smoked-glass bottle with a gold cap on wet black stone, then the reshoot's second camera on the same moment, cut on the beat. Frames checked at 3 per second: the bottle keeps its shape, cap and colours across both shots, and there is no text or logo anywhere. The second camera's dolly back barely shows, so the two shots read as one slow hero shot. Sound measured at -14.7 LUFS, not judged by ear.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: Hero still
raw_steps.prompt: Luxury advertising photograph of {product} standing on wet black obsidian, thin emerald rim light, gold dust suspended in the air, shallow depth of field, dark studio background. No text, no logos.

raw_steps.label: Hero shot
raw_steps.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Product advertising film, cinematic. The faceted smoked-glass perfume bottle with its gold cap stands still on the wet black stone, unchanged from first frame to last. Gold dust drifts slowly through the light, a thin line of water runs across the stone, and the thin straight emerald line of light behind it stays where it is. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the product. One continuous shot, no cuts.

overall_soundscape: A low soft hum, tiny water drips.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

raw_steps.label: Second camera
raw_steps.prompt: The same faceted smoked-glass perfume bottle with the same gold cap stands still on the wet black stone, its shape and colours unchanged, gold dust drifting through the light
